name: coc-htmlview
description: Browser-style HTML and CSS rendering into Neovim buffers for coc.nvim extensions
author: Svetlozar Iliev

htmlview.view.mode.markdownDescription: Where views open when the calling extension does not choose: a window `split` (see `#htmlview.view.splitCommand#`) or a centred `float` (Neovim only; Vim always splits).

htmlview.view.splitCommand.markdownDescription: Ex command that creates the split for `#htmlview.view.mode#` `split`, e.g. `botright vsplit`, `topleft split`, `tab split`. Anything that is not a split command falls back to the default with one warning.

htmlview.stylesheets.markdownDescription: CSS files applied to every view as your base, before the calling extension's stylesheets, so the extension's rules win over them. `~` and environment variables are expanded. Relative paths resolve against the folder of the settings file that sets them: your coc config folder for the user settings, the workspace root for the workspace settings; both lists apply, user first. Defaults declared by other extensions are ignored.

htmlview.linkTargets.markdownDescription: Show each link's target as virtual text after the link (` 🔗 <href>`). Off by default, as in a browser; links stay highlighted and `<CR>`/`gx` open them either way.
